# Unknown EWS providers gain an OAuth option only through the customization preference

The original gate exposes the OAuth2 menu item when experimental.mail.ews.overrideOAuth.enabled is true and incoming.type is ews, without requiring a registered provider. Otherwise hostname/provider lookup still decides visibility. The accepted later method uses the Exchange predicate and also resets a disallowed OAuth selection; those are separate phases. Showing the option does not establish successful custom-provider authentication.

Scope: Account Hub incoming authentication visibility.
